title: MLaKE: Multilingual Knowledge Editing Benchmark for Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces and evaluates a multilingual knowledge editing benchmark. Although the dataset includes 'religion or worldview' as one of the many factual relations sourced from Wikidata, the core objective of the research is to assess the efficiency and transferability of knowledge editing in LLMs across different languages, rather than benchmarking religion, ethics, or morals.
